S_BCNT1_I32_B64.description: Count the number of "1" bits in a scalar input, store the result into a scalar register and set SCC iff the result is nonzero.

V_READFIRSTLANE_B32.description: Read the scalar value in the lowest active lane of the input vector register and store it into a scalar register.

V_LSHLREV_B64.description: Given a shift count in the first vector input, calculate the logical shift left of the second vector input and store the result into a vector register.

V_LSHRREV_B64.description: Given a shift count in the first vector input, calculate the logical shift right of the second vector input and store the result into a vector register.

V_BCNT_U32_B32.description: Count the number of "1" bits in the vector input and store the result into a vector register.

V_AND_OR_B32.description: Calculate bitwise AND on the first two vector inputs, then compute the bitwise OR of the intermediate result and the third vector input, then store the final result into a vector register.
